en:
The grotesque monster sank into the sand,
taking many mysteries with it.{w}
note: Follows row 1016 (slice_012): 'igyou no monsutaa' = grotesque monster; align with slice_012's wording if it differs.

en: Suddenly, a voice rang out.{w}
Voice
"Come forth, two of you."{w}
note: 'futari de maire': imperious order; read as 'only two may come' (party-size restriction?). 'two of you' keeps that reading without asserting the party is two people.

en: And then your bodies were hurled out of the room.{w}
Menolist
note: Spelling from slice_001 'Menolist's Candlestick'. One of the Great Demon Dukes (MON_TEXT 310): gentle, gentlemanly speech, candlestick head.

en:
"Ah, pardon me!{w}My name is Menolist!"{w}{p}"The truth is, I have lost my way!{w}Might I ask, incidentally -- Seirion-Daera...
that would be this Zefkaka here, would it not?"{w}
note: New names: Serion-Daera (dungeon; DGN_SET spells it the same, DGN_NAME/BGM_NAME have the variant Seirion=Daera) and Zefkaka (unknown; apparently what Menolist calls this place). Polite gentleman register per MON_TEXT.

en: "So you are the new apostles -- the Ryug?"
note: Yes/no prompt (data row) asked by Menolist ('anata-gata' = the party). 'atarashiki to' = new apostles/disciples; 'apostle' echoes the game subtitle. Ryug per wmap slice_20 (Fourth Generation people, MON_TEXT 321). 41 chars: if this box has the ~30 menu limit, short form: 'You're the new apostles, the Ryug?'.

en: A cactus came up close.{w}Its spines stuck right into you.{w}
*   Ouch, that hurts!!   *{w}
note: Centred banner; leading spaces mirror the source frame (style of the wmap banners).

en: Combat Teacher
note: 'bujutsu no sensei' = teacher of the Martial Arts Department; 'Martial Arts Teacher' (20) too long for a name box.

en:
"Show 'em the true grit of the Santorea Martial Arts Department!"{w}{p}"How far will your strength get you
against Professor Rombino?{w}Anyone who wants in, take your turns!"{w}
note: 'sokoiji' read as deep-down grit (not 'malice'). Rombino = monster 'great teacher' of the Martial Arts Tournament (MON_TEXT 285). 'sensei' -> Professor (name box: Prof.).

en: Will you take part?

"Your fighting spirit's way too weak!{w}Don't let Professor Rombino's adorable looks
overwhelm youuuu!!!"{w}
"By the way, the last champions were this bunch here!"{w}
note: The game presumably shows the previous winners right after.

en: "All right then, go on, one at a time!!{w}Get fired up, and... GO!"{w}
note: 'harikitte, go!' rendered the same in 1086.

en: "Whoa, that's amazing!{w}You won! The championship's yours!!"{w}
note: 'yours' left number-neutral: entrants go one at a time (1087 uses singular 'anata').

en: "Come back and play again, y'hear!"{w}

note: No pronoun for Rombino (gender not in glossary). The stick is probably the whistle these Professors hold in their mouths (MON_TEXT 284); kept vague as in the source.

en: Prof. Rombino
note: New name (monster, MONSTER3/MON_TEXT). Name-box form 'Prof.' to stay under 16.

en: "Gyuuu."{w}
note: Creature noise, kept as sound.

en: "Booo."{w}
note: Pouty 'boo' noise.

en: "Grind grind grind grind grind grind..."{w}
note: 'guriguri' = grinding/twisting noise; six repeats kept.

en: Professor Rombino looked displeased.{w}
Male Student

"That special guest lecturer, right?{w}Kinda loud, and way too intense, huh?"{w}{p}"Ronde?{w}Oh, it's Professor Mandelgius, isn't it?{w}Can't tell whether even the name sounds impressive or not..."{w}
note: 'Ronde?' kept as the student's half-remembered guess at the name before correcting to Mandelgius (glossary); uncertain. 'atsukurushii' = stifling/over-intense.

en: 3rd-Yr Swords
note: Swordsmanship Department, 3rd year. Speaker is female (her boyfriend is 'kare'). Name boxes in this slice use '<N>-Yr <Dept>'.

en: "I'm dating a junior from the Magic Department,{w}so wouldn't it be great if he transferred into Swordsmanship?"{w}{p}"Then I could help him study,{w}we could eat our packed lunches together,{w}and in an empty classroom once everyone's gone............ you know?"{w}
note: 'kare' = he (boyfriend), stated in source. Likely the same couple as row 1093.

en: 2nd-Year Student

"Our swordsmanship teacher is amazing with a blade,{w}but I can never tell what the teacher's saying."{w}{p}"It's all 'Zwaah!' and 'Zweah!' and stuff...{w}But the weird part is, when I yell that too while swinging my sword,
I kind of get it."{w}
note: Teacher's gender unknown: no pronoun ('the teacher').

en: 3rd-Year Student

"Me and some friends are sneaking off
to the casino in Teridon soon!{w}I'm gonna hit it big!"{w}
note: Teridon spelling from wmap slices 17/18.

en: Female Student
note: onna-seito; 1057 joshi-seito also 'Female Student'.

en:
"Welcome to the Sewing Club.{w}We're making pieces to show at the upcoming school festival.{w}The theme is our 'Huge Clothes Even Giants Can Wear' special!"{w}{p}"Something a bit outlandish is better
for catching the new students' eyes, y'know?"{w}
"Panties that'll fit a big butt?{w}I happen to be making something big right now, but...{w}Heave... ho! There, here you go."{w}
note: Part of the Teridon panties quest (wmap slices 18/19). 'pantsu' = panties as in wmap slice_18.

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Custom Panties.{w}
note: Item 'tokuchuu pantsu' = Custom Panties (14 chars; ITEM_PRIZ max 18). Format from slice_001.

en: "But can anybody actually wear those?{w}In Teridon? Huh, really."{w}
"So how were the custom panties I made?{w}Did that kid in Teridon{w}like them, do you think?"{w}
note: 'ko' = kid, gender-neutral.

en: "Oh, you're the next challengers, huh?{w}Go on over to the Alchemy Department's lab and...{w}wait, huh?"{w}
Female Student

note: 'haikousha' = the abandoned school building, i.e. the old mansion in Perpeco Forest. 'reitai' = spirit-type monsters.
Syllable-by-syllable 'o-ko-ra-na-i' mirrored with hyphens.

en: Both Students
note: seito futari speaking in unison.

en: "Just go for it, big time!"{w}

"Santorea Academy's New Student Welcome~
Now on at the old mansion in the Perpeco Forest!{w}If you've got guts, come join in, the more the merrier!"{w}
note: gakufu = Academy (chap slice_004).

en: "Aw, so you weren't new students after all.{w}No wonder you're so strong..."{w}
"But it was fun, wasn't it?{w}That place has quite the atmosphere, right?"{w}

"Man, though, a Mirurubana?
That's one elaborate costume you pulled off."{w}
note: Said to the female student (she answers in 1066). New name: Mirurubana (undead-type monster, MONSTER1 next to Lich).

en: "Huh? I didn't dress up.{w}Wasn't that you?"{w}
"AAAAAAAAAGH!"{w}
2nd-Yr Martial
note: Martial Arts Department, 2nd year. Scene is a tabletop-RPG session.

en: "Game Master,{w}I'll try tapping that wall there with my staff."{w}
Game Master
"Nothing happens."{w}
2nd-Yr Magic
"Okay, let's move on, then."{w}
"Danger Sense check. The target number is 14."{w}
note: tasseichi = TRPG target number.

en: "Huh?"{w}
"You didn't search the floor, did you?"{w}
"Heyyy, thief, what've you been doing!?"{w}
note: Shouted at the group's thief character, who then rolls 15 (1080) and alone avoids the trap.

en: 2nd-Yr Swords
"15. That's over the target, so I dodge."{w}
"Don't go dodging it all by yourselfffff!!"{w}
Organizer
note: Host of the Magical Party (EVENT_TEXT 37).

en:
"Come one, come all!
The Magical Party venue
is right this way!"{w}{p}"Your magic power -- how far will it get you
against Professor Nambino?{w}Anyone who wants to join, take your turns, please~"{w}
note: Mirrors 1028. Nambino = monster 'great teacher' of the Magical Party (MON_TEXT 284).

en: "We'll be waiting, so come play anytime~"{w}
"Oh, and our previous champions are... right here!"{w}
"All right then, go ahead, one at a time!{w}Get fired up, and... GO!"{w}
"Wow, wow! You're the champion!"{w}
note: anata singular.
Music-note symbol replaced by '~' (ASCII only).

en: "Come play again, okay!"{w}

note: Same as 1036; MON_TEXT says Nambino holds a whistle in the mouth.

en: Prof. Nambino
note: New name (monster, MONSTER3/MON_TEXT).

en: Professor Nambino looked displeased.{w}

"I'm going out with an upperclassman from Swordsmanship, but{w}...well, it's kind of hard to hold my head up."{w}{p}"Stuff like 'What do you see in a muscle-woman?'{w}or 'She's got you under her thumb, huh?'...{w}that's what everyone says to me."{w}{p}"If she'd at least put on some glasses
and fake looking a little brainy...{w}N-not that I've got a thing for girls in glasses or anything!"{w}
note: Partner is female (kinniku-onna). Read the glasses wish as about her, then the speaker's flustered denial. Speaker's own gender not needed in English. Probably the boyfriend from 1045.

en: Troubled Girl
note: nayameru onna-seito; 'Troubled Female Student' too long.

en:
"Studying magic is such a pain...{w}I can do it without knowing
the theory anyway..."{w}
note: Subject restored as 'I' (her own grumbling).

en: New Student
note: Speaker of row 1097 (slice_014).
